title: Artifact reference, version 1
description: A durable reference to one immutable stored artifact. Embedded in dataset snapshot manifests, run manifests and API payloads, so the shape is versioned explicitly.

schema_version.description: Version of this artifact reference shape.

logical_uri.description: Deployment-independent address, nas://<namespace>/<key>. A machine mount path is never stored; each deployment maps a namespace to a mount root.

sha256.description: SHA-256 digest of the artifact bytes, lowercase hex, unprefixed.

size_bytes.description: Exact byte size of the artifact.

media_type.description: Bare <type>/<subtype>, lowercase, without parameters or wildcards.
